_about: MegaWheel Kids fixed cast. Identity lives here; physics lives in VEHICLES (generators/physics_2d/sim_engine.py). Add new characters on purpose (a planned debut), never auto-generate them. Rules: cast/CAST.md.

characters.name: Zippy
characters.personality: Super fast and a little show-off. Always sure he will win, always in a hurry.

characters.name: Buster

characters.personality: Strong helper who loves splashing water. Loud, cheerful, a bit clumsy.

characters.intro: Level {lvl}! Grizzly the monster truck! Can Grizzly smash through the {obst}?

characters.name: Nitro
characters.personality: The fastest racer on the track. Impatient, loves speed more than anything.
characters.intro: Level {lvl}! Nitro the race car! Super fast... but can Nitro handle the {obst}?

characters.name: Tilly
characters.personality: Friendly and chatty. Knows every road in town and loves giving friends a ride.
characters.intro: Level {lvl}! Tilly the taxi! Hop in... can Tilly get past the {obst}?

characters.name: Titan
characters.personality: The biggest truck on the road. Calm gentle giant, super strong but slow.
characters.intro: Level {lvl}! Titan the big rig! The biggest truck on the road... can Titan make it?

characters.name: Sprinkles
characters.personality: Sweet and bubbly. Every kid's favourite, always playing a happy tune.
